properties.name: A build script, a Makefile or a CI step reads a report from the design without an agent session
properties.statement: Promoted 2026-09-20 on Anthony's word. bhome's plan-sheet generator read the budget from a hand-transcribed file 'because reflow2 is an MCP server and not a library the script can import', so the half of the sheet the design owned was the half with no mechanical guarantee. A consumer must be able to read any served report from a shell, get JSON, and get an exit code it can branch on. BUILT in v0.65.0 as `--call <tool> --args '<json>'`: it runs the tool through the same path a session uses, so refusals are worded the same and usage is recorded the same; a read-only tool still answers while a server holds the graph, from the snapshot the export already uses, and a writer refuses.
